overview:
Florida's 17th District leans Republican by about ten points, and incumbent Greg Steube is seeking re-election. He has raised roughly $1.6 million and holds about $2.1 million on hand, while Democratic challenger Matthew Montavon has raised near $148,000 with under $35,000 available. An independent candidate trails far behind in both money and visibility. No public polls of the race are available, and no expert ratings have been issued.

Prediction markets give the Democratic side roughly a four percent chance of winning. With the district's partisan lean, the incumbency advantage, and the wide financial gap all pointing the same way, Steube is favored by about fifteen points and the race is rated Likely Republican. The absence of polling keeps uncertainty elevated, but nothing in the available evidence currently suggests a competitive contest.
